openings.claim: Replace quantity deduplication with a row-preserving ledger: supplied conversion only, retain originals; inclusion depends on supported row lineage, status meaning and cutoff eligibility. Exclude superseded contributions only when explicit replacement relationships justify exclusion. Duplicate, unmatched and superseded rows remain visible; an unlinked differently identified replacement remains an alternative, never an assumed duplicate.
openings.discriminator: Against normalized sums with quantity-based duplicate removal, the ledger should expose competing amendment interpretations rather than silently delete legitimate equal-quantity transfers or double-count already represented corrections.
openings.probe: Freeze both variants on clean/disturbed copies before opening the sealed key. Within twenty extra minutes compare resolved-batch counts, unsupported definite claims and request counts; inspect the ambiguous amendment. Defeat: unsupported definite quantity, any row loss, or failure to finish twelve batches within sixty minutes.
openings.uncertainty: Recorded links may not establish cross-report identity; absence leaves bounded disagreement. Spreadsheet/script implementation must fit supplied reviewer capacity; no speed advantage is established.

openings.claim: Which missing linkage/status evidence distinguishes recorded quantity alternatives? Choose at most three requests by unresolved inclusion decisions, naming the missing superseded-row reference, cross-report replacement linkage record or undefined-status definition as applicable.
openings.discriminator: Rival requests for complete replacement reports may leave effective-time/row-identity ambiguity intact. Linkage would support correction equivalence; distinct-transaction evidence would support separate inclusion; neither observation is supplied.
openings.probe: Before requesting, document candidate responses and differing inclusion consequences. On the disturbed copy, keep the removed reference and undefined code flagged. Defeat: nondiscriminating request or unavailable records; retain disagreement.
openings.uncertainty: Follow-up availability and responses are unknown; review completion cannot depend on receiving them.
